case_name: Nawal Kishore Prasad v State of Biahr and Others
holding: The impugned order of the Division Bench to the extent it has refused any relief to the appellant cannot be sustained and to that extent the impugned order is set aside.

The appellant shall be paid his salary for two years together with all the allowances from the date he attained the age of 58 years to the date he attained the age of 60 years after deducting the amount, if any, paid by way of pension for those two years.
The pension of the appellant shall also be refixed taking our order into consideration.
cases_cited: Nawal Kishore Prasad v State of Biahr
